title: Palantir Q1 2026 earnings release
excerpt: Q1 2026 revenue was USD 1.633 billion, GAAP operating margin was 46%, cash from operations was USD 899 million, and full-year revenue guidance was raised to USD 7.650-7.662 billion.
summary: Palantir reported exceptional Q1 growth, GAAP profitability and cash generation, raised 2026 guidance, and USD 8.0 billion of cash and short-term Treasury securities; stock compensation and diluted shares remain material valuation inputs.
